name: VideoMap

params.description: 视频 或 流链接。支持 flv, m3u8, map4 格式。
params.name: options.url

params.description: 水平方向上以像素为单位的焦距。
params.name: options.videoParameters.fovX

params.description: 垂直方向上以像素为单位的焦距。
params.name: options.videoParameters.fovY

params.description: 视频地图宽度，没设置时默认获取视频宽度
params.name: options.videoWidth

params.description: 视频地图高度，没设置时默认获取视频高度
params.name: options.videoHeight

usage:
// 浏览器
<script type="text/javascript" src="https://iclient.supermap.io/dist/mapboxgl/iclient-mapboxgl.js"></script>
<script type="text/javascript" src="https://iclient.supermap.io/web/libs/opencv/3.4/opencv.js"></script>
<script>
  new mapboxgl.supermap.VideoMap(options);

</script>

 // ES6 Import
import { VideoMap } from "@supermapgis/iclient-mapboxgl";
// 将上面 opencv 源码拷贝到本地路径引用
options.opencv = "your opencv path";
new VideoMap(options);
usageCodeBrowser:
<script type='text/javascript' src="https://iclient.supermap.io/dist/mapboxgl/iclient-mapboxgl.js"></script>
<script>
  new mapboxgl.supermap.VideoMap(options, options.url, options.videoParameters, options.videoParameters.pitch, options.videoParameters.roll, options.videoParameters.yaw, options.videoParameters.x, options.videoParameters.y, options.videoParameters.z, options.videoParameters.fovX, options.videoParameters.fovY, options.videoParameters.centerX, options.videoParameters.centerY, options.container, options.opencv, options.videoWidth, options.videoHeight, options.styleOptions, options.autoplay, options.loop);
</script>
usageCodeES6:
import { VideoMap } from '@supermapgis/iclient-mapboxgl';

new VideoMap(options, options.url, options.videoParameters, options.videoParameters.pitch, options.videoParameters.roll, options.videoParameters.yaw, options.videoParameters.x, options.videoParameters.y, options.videoParameters.z, options.videoParameters.fovX, options.videoParameters.fovY, options.videoParameters.centerX, options.videoParameters.centerY, options.container, options.opencv, options.videoWidth, options.videoHeight, options.styleOptions, options.autoplay, options.loop);
